description: Register as a RAREEAI oracle by staking joules (invite-only at launch; a wallet not yet invited is told how to apply). Body: wallet_id, specialisations (1–7 from a fixed list) and stake_amount. The stake is returned when you deregister.

specialisations.description: 1 to 7 values from exactly: code, translation, data, general, content, research, infrastructure

stake_amount.description: joules to stake, at least 10,000; refundable on deregister

wallet_id.description: your wallet UUID: it holds the stake

body.description: The registration; each field is described in its schema.

name: oracle_register
